note: Small pets (docs/animal/PLAN.md §3). The main view is the side profile (D-14), so every desc is written to read from the left side: where each pair of legs is, how the back curves, where the ears point. Adults only; no cages, food, bedding or toys.

rodent.ja: モルモット・ハムスター

forms.desc: rising up on its long hind feet to look around: body upright, hind feet flat on the ground, front paws held loosely in front of the chest off the ground, long ears straight up, head facing forward

forms.species: adult domestic rabbit with a rounded body, long hind feet, short front legs and two long upright ears

forms.species: adult domestic rabbit with a rounded body, long hind feet, short front legs and two long upright ears
